title: flash-agent thin MCP client CLI + end-to-end MCP spec
description: Depends on 0613-agent-bridge-mvp-protocol-package-vite-ws-relay- and 0614-agent-command-registry-full-rpc-method-surface-o. Most agents connect as MCP clients directly (claude mcp add --transport http flash-editor http://localhost:1420/mcp) — this CLI is a THIN generic wrapper for shell scripting, e2e tests, and humans, built on the @modelcontextprotocol/sdk client. New workspace package packages/agent-cli (@flash/agent-cli, bin flash-agent, Node>=18). Commands (docs/19-agent-interface.md §The flash-agent CLI): tools (list tools with schemas); call <tool> [json|--k=v ...] (invoke any tool, print result JSON); read <resource-uri>; screenshot [-o stage.png] and publish [-o out.swf] sugar that write binary outputs to files; repl (interactive session on one connection); --url flag (default http://localhost:1420/mcp). NO bespoke per-command argument tree — call + self-describing schemas cover everything. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 tool error (isError), 2 transport error (message says whether the dev server or the editor page is missing and how to start each). Add a root package.json script alias. Tests: e2e spec in apps/desktop/e2e driving the real CLI as a subprocess against the auto-started Vite server + editor page: call stage_add_shape → call timeline_insert_keyframe → call script_set (assert diagnostics in output) → call doc_get assertion → screenshot file exists → publish output decodes via @flash/swf round-trip. Update AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md with a short 'controlling the editor' section: the claude mcp add one-liner + pointer to docs/19.
